<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Willowbrook Pasture</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#7ec3e8}
#scene{display:block;width:100vw;height:100vh}
text{font-family:Georgia,"Palatino Linotype","Book Antiqua","Times New Roman",serif}

/* ---------- ambient loops ---------- */
#rays{animation:spin 54s linear infinite;transform-origin:1296px 168px}
#glow{animation:breathe 7s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:1296px 168px}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes breathe{50%{transform:scale(1.07)}}
.tree{animation:sway 6.6s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:0 0}
.sway{animation:wind 3.6s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:0 0}
.wing{animation:flapw .19s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:0 0}
@keyframes sway{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-1.5deg)}50%{transform:rotate(1.9deg)}}
@keyframes wind{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-4deg)}50%{transform:rotate(5.5deg)}}
@keyframes flapw{0%,100%{transform:scaleX(1)}50%{transform:scaleX(.28)}}
@keyframes flapv{0%,100%{transform:scaleY(1)}50%{transform:scaleY(.28)}}
.tail{animation:swish 2.7s ease-in-out infinite}
.mane{animation:swish 3.4s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:30px -166px}
@keyframes swish{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-5deg)}50%{transform:rotate(6deg)}}

/* ---------- animals ---------- */
.animal{cursor:pointer}
.hop{animation:hop var(--t) cubic-bezier(.35,.05,.55,.95) infinite;animation-delay:var(--d);transform-origin:0 0;will-change:transform}
.shd{animation:shd var(--t) cubic-bezier(.35,.05,.55,.95) infinite;animation-delay:var(--d);transform-origin:0 4px}
@keyframes hop{
 0%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1,1)}
 10%{transform:translateY(4px) scale(1.05,.93)}
 28%{transform:translateY(calc(var(--a)*-1)) scale(.96,1.07)}
 46%{transform:translateY(calc(var(--a)*-1)) scale(1,1)}
 66%{transform:translateY(calc(var(--a)*-.2)) scale(1.01,1)}
 82%{transform:translateY(2px) scale(1.04,.95)}
 100%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1,1)}}
@keyframes big{
 0%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1,1)}
 12%{transform:translateY(6px) scale(1.09,.9)}
 40%{transform:translateY(calc(var(--a)*-2.2)) scale(.94,1.1)}
 58%{transform:translateY(calc(var(--a)*-2.1)) rotate(2deg)}
 82%{transform:translateY(3px) scale(1.07,.93)}
 100%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1,1)}}
@keyframes shd{0%{opacity:.3;transform:scaleX(1)}10%{opacity:.36;transform:scaleX(1.05)}
 30%{opacity:.15;transform:scaleX(.84)}46%{opacity:.14;transform:scaleX(.82)}70%{opacity:.28;transform:scaleX(1)}}
.animal.bolt .hop{animation-name:big;animation-duration:.62s}
.fig{transition:transform .32s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);transform-origin:0 0}
.animal:hover .fig,.animal.peek .fig{transform:translateY(-4px) scale(1.02)}
.animal:hover,.animal.peek{z-index:2}
.tag{opacity:0;transform:translateY(9px);transition:opacity .28s ease,transform .34s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);pointer-events:none}
.animal:hover .tag,.animal.peek .tag{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}

/* ---------- chrome ---------- */
#hud{position:fixed;top:26px;left:32px;pointer-events:none}
#hud .kick{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-bottom:12px;font:600 11px/1 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#0d3a22;opacity:.8}
.dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#e0533f;animation:ping 2.1s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes ping{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(224,83,63,.55)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 13px rgba(224,83,63,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(224,83,63,0)}}
#hud h1{margin:0;font:400 56px/.84 Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;letter-spacing:-1.2px;color:#fffdf3;text-shadow:0 4px 22px rgba(16,58,38,.4)}
#hud h1 span{display:block;margin-top:15px;font:700 13px/1 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.46em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#0f3d25;opacity:.7;text-shadow:none}
#hud .meta{margin:17px 0 0;max-width:340px;font:400 12.5px/1.55 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;color:#0d3320;opacity:.66}
#legend{position:fixed;left:32px;bottom:28px;display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;max-width:62vw}
#legend button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:9px 13px 9px 10px;border:0;border-left:4px solid #6fae4e;border-radius:4px 8px 8px 4px;background:#fff8e9;color:#173a24;font:700 11px/1 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(14,52,32,.22);transition:transform .22s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),box-shadow .22s,background .22s}
#legend button:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);background:#fffdf6;box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(14,52,32,.3)}
#legend i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;display:block}
#sig{position:fixed;right:26px;bottom:24px;margin:0;font:600 10px/1.4 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.9);text-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(20,60,40,.5);pointer-events:none}
@media (max-width:700px){#hud h1{font-size:34px}#hud .meta{display:none}}
</style>
</head>
